versos.texto_bv: A cisterna em que Ismael havia lançado todos os cadáveres dos homens que havia matado ao lado de Gedalias era a mesma que o rei Asa havia feito por causa de Baasa, rei de Israel. Ismael, filho de Netanias, encheu-a de mortos.
versos.traducao_literal: E a cisterna, na qual lançou ali Ismael todos os cadáveres dos homens que feriu — pela mão de Gedalias —, ela, a que fez o rei Asa por causa de Baasa, rei de Israel, a ela encheu Ismael, filho de Netanias, de mortos.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0031): A expressão hebraica בְּיַד גְּדַלְיָהוּ tem sentido causal/associativo ('por causa de / em conexão com Gedalias'), não espacial. O texto BV atual rende como 'ao lado de Gedalias' (sentido espacial), o que altera o que o texto afirma: os homens mortos não foram mortos 'ao lado de' Gedalias no sentido físico, mas sim no contexto do assassinato de Gedalias (eram seus associados/pessoal). — evidência: termos_originais: בְּיַד (preposição 'by/at the hand of') + גְּדַלְיָהוּ; KJV: 'whom he had slain because of Gedaliah'; contexto imediato (vv.2-3): os mortos eram judeus e caldeus que estavam com Gedalias em Mispá — mortos em conexão com o assassinato de Gedalias, não espacialmente ao seu lado.

kjv.texto: Now the pit wherein Ishmael had cast all the dead bodies of the men, whom he had slain because of Gedaliah, was it which Asa the king had made for fear of Baasha king of Israel: and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah filled it with them that were slain.

vizinhos.8: But ten men were found among them that said unto Ishmael, Slay us not: for we have treasures in the field, of wheat, and of barley, and of oil, and of honey. So he forbare, and slew them not among their brethren.
vizinhos.10: Then Ishmael carried away captive all the residue of the people that were in Mizpah, even the king’s daughters, and all the people that remained in Mizpah, whom Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard had committed to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam: and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah carried them away captive, and departed to go over to the Ammonites.

web.texto: Now the pit in which Ishmael cast all the dead bodies of the men whom he had killed, by the side of Gedaliah (the same was who which Asa the king had made for fear of Baasha king of Israel), Ishmael the son of Nethaniah filled it with those who were killed.

vizinhos.8: But ten men were found among those who said to Ishmael, Don’t kill us; for we have stores hidden in the field, of wheat, and of barley, and of oil, and of honey. So he stopped, and didn’t kill them among their brothers.
vizinhos.10: Then Ishmael carried away captive all the residue of the people who were in Mizpah, even the king’s daughters, and all the people who remained in Mizpah, whom Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had committed to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam; Ishmael the son of Nethaniah carried them away captive, and departed to go over to the children of Ammon.
